title: The Point Where Cartography Admits Defeat

features.name: the-territory-that-ate-itself
features.desc-on-touch: a massive paper map pinned to a frame, but the map shows the map showing the map—nested infinitely, each scale revealing more of the previous. the center reads: 'YOU ARE HERE (APPROXIMATELY NEVER)'

features.name: the-instruments-that-stopped-measuring
features.desc-on-touch: compasses, theodolites, sextants arranged on a table, all pointing in the same direction regardless of orientation. someone has adjusted them so carefully they no longer measure the world, only each other's agreement.

features.name: the-altitude-where-seeing-fails
features.desc-on-touch: a tall observation tower, but the view from the top reveals only the tower itself from all angles—distance has stopped working. every direction shows the same structure at the same scale.

features.name: the-reflection-that-corrected-itself
features.desc-on-touch: a perfectly still pool reflects a landscape that doesn't match anything above it. the reflection is more accurate to the territory than the territory is. visitors study the water longer than they study the actual sky.

inscription: the last coordinate is the one that knows it does not exist

file.name: Final_Cartographic_Notation_Unfinished.txt
file.note: a surveyor's final report, abandoned mid-sentence: 'Having established that the territory contains the map which contains the territory which contains... I propose that we stop. Coordinates 0,0 herewi

exits.label: back down to the apartments where numbers meant nothing
higher still, where maps become abstract diagrams
into territories that have never been claimed
